content_html:
The world's railway map

An interactive railway map of the world: 1,249 notable train routes across 120 countries. High-speed, classic, night, scenic, heritage and luxury lines, with the facts behind every one.

From the Glacier Express, the Bernina Express and the Trans-Siberian to the Shinkansen, the Eurostar and the California Zephyr: every route is drawn on a fullscreen world map with its distance, fastest journey time, top speed, operator, rolling stock and the year the line opened. Free, no signup. The interactive map needs JavaScript; the index below reaches the same atlas as static pages.

Explore the atlas

  • All 1249 routes the full atlas index, by category
  • Every route by the numbers one sortable table: distance, time, speed, year, ridership
  • Fastest train in every country ranked by real average speed, not top speed
  • Europe train map 742 routes on one map
  • USA train map Amtrak long-distance lines & scenic railroads
  • Night trains 108 sleeper routes, with per-city pages
  • The night-train revival 22 sleepers back since 2016, charted by decade
  • The highest railways in the world 53 lines ranked by altitude, up to 5,072 m
  • The longest train journeys 104 rides over 1,000 km, up to 9,289 km on the Trans-Siberian
  • International train routes 105 cross-border trains linking 59 countries
  • Train vs plane door-to-door times & CO₂e on 109 European city pairs
  • Scenic train routes the lines you ride for the window seat
  • Heritage & museum railways preserved steam lines and vintage excursions, by country
  • Mountain railways the rack and cable lines that climb what ordinary trains cannot
  • Luxury train routes the trains you ride for the train itself
  • Train routes by country 90 countries

  • About one person’s hobby project; corrections logged and credited
  • City to city 670 journey guides: times, changes, operators

Recently corrected

  • This site is now World Train Map, at worldtrainmap.com. It was TrainRouter, and that name promised something this has never been. A router plans your journey; it asks where you are, where you are going and when, and hands back a departure. This is an atlas. It draws 1,247 notable passenger routes and tells you what each one is, how far it runs, how long it takes and why it is worth knowing about, and it has never once sold a ticket or read a timetable at you. People arrived expecting a planner and left when they did not find one. The new name is what the thing actually is. Nothing you had is lost: every trainrouter.com address redirects here in a single step and keeps its path, so an old bookmark, an old link in somebody else's article and an old search result all land exactly where they used to, on the same page. That redirect stays up permanently. The map, the data, the route pages and their addresses after the domain are all unchanged, and so is the light or dark setting your browser remembers for this site, which would have been quietly forgotten had the name behind it been tidied up along with everything else. 2026-08-11
  • Eleven hundred lines are now drawn from the relation that describes them rather than from a search for them. Until today most "OSM traced" lines here were found by pulling the track inside a corridor and looking for a path across it, which is inference, and inference picks the wrong railway where two run side by side and rounds what it does find until the line sits a couple of hundred metres off the rail it means. A route relation is the other thing entirely: somebody who knows that railway listed the exact ways it uses, in order. The atlas now asks which relation a train belongs to by asking the stations it calls at, because a relation lists the stops it serves and proximity cannot tell a service from track it happens to share. Of 1,247 routes, 647 are answered by one relation covering the whole card and 176 by a chain of them. 1,093 lines were redrawn from those answers and almost none of it is a change of alignment: 1,098 of the candidates were the same railway drawn coarsely, now a median of four metres from OpenStreetMap instead of an approximation. The atlas draws 1,122 of its lines from a named relation, and measures 1,243 of them against real track at 98 per cent agreement. 2026-08-10
  • Twenty two routes were deliberately left alone, and it is worth saying why rather than quietly redrawing them. Their relation would move the line more than a kilometre, and that is the signature of a different railway rather than a finer drawing of the same one. Kyiv to Lviv sits 42 km from its candidate and the Roros line 51 km, which is either a badly wrong drawing or a relation for another railway entirely, and nothing here can tell which without somebody reading what the relation is actually called. They keep their current drawing until that is done. A further 424 routes have no relation at all, which is not a failure of the method but a fact about the map: OpenStreetMap has no route relation for much of Africa, Central Asia and South America. 2026-08-10

Errors get fixed, usually within a day: the corrections log.

blocks.html_en: • Twenty two routes were deliberately left alone, and it is worth saying why rather than quietly redrawing them. Their relation would move the line more than a kilometre, and that is the signature of a different railway rather than a finer drawing of the same one. Kyiv to Lviv sits 42 km from its candidate and the Roros line 51 km, which is either a badly wrong drawing or a relation for another railway entirely, and nothing here can tell which without somebody reading what the relation is actually called. They keep their current drawing until that is done. A further 424 routes have no relation at all, which is not a failure of the method but a fact about the map: OpenStreetMap has no route relation for much of Africa, Central Asia and South America. 2026-08-10

content_html_zh:
世界铁路图

交互式世界铁路地图：跨越 120 个国家/地区的 1,249 条著名火车路线。 高速、经典、夜间、风景、遗产和豪华线路，每一条背后都有事实真相。

从冰川快车、伯尔尼纳快车和西伯利亚大铁路，到新干线、欧洲之星和加州和风号：每条路线都绘制在全屏世界地图上，包括距离、最快行程时间、最高时速、运营商、机车车辆以及线路开通年份。 免费，无需注册。 交互式地图需要JavaScript；下面的索引达到了与静态页面相同的图集。

探索地图集

  • 所有 1249 条航线的完整地图集索引（按类别）
  • 每条路线都按数字排序：距离、时间、速度、年份、客流量
  • 每个国家最快的火车按实际平均速度排名，而不是最高速度
  • 欧洲火车地图 一张地图上有 742 条路线
  • 美国火车地图 Amtrak 长途线路和风景优美的铁路
  • 夜行列车 108 条卧铺路线，附有每个城市的页面
  • 自 2016 年以来，夜行列车的复兴已恢复 22 趟卧铺列车，按十年划分
  • 世界上最高的铁路 53 条线路按海拔排名，高达 5,072 m
  • 最长的火车行程 104 趟行程超过 1,000 公里，西伯利亚大铁路最长可达 9,289 公里
  • 国际班列线路 105列跨境班列连接59个国家
  • 109 对欧洲城市的火车与飞机门到门时间和二氧化碳排放量
  • 风景优美的火车路线为您乘坐靠窗座位的线路
  • 按国家/地区划分的遗产和博物馆铁路、保留的蒸汽线路和复古游览
  • 山地铁路的机架和电缆线路可以爬升普通火车无法爬升的高度
  • 豪华火车路线 您乘坐的火车是火车本身
  • 按国家划分的火车路线 90 个国家
  • 以 CSV、JSON 和 GeoJSON 格式打开每条路线的数据集（事实 CC BY 4.0）
  • 关于一个人的爱好项目；更正已记录并记入贷方
  • 城市到城市 670 旅程指南：时代、变化、运营商

最近更正

  • 该网站现在是世界火车地图，网址为 worldtrainmap.com。 它就是 TrainRouter，这个名字承诺了一些从未实现过的事情。 路由器规划你的旅程；它会询问您在哪里、要去哪里以及何时前往，然后返回出发信息。 这是一本地图集。 它绘制了 1,247 条著名的客运路线，并告诉您每条路线是什么、运行多远、需要多长时间以及为什么值得了解，并且它从未向您出售过机票或阅读时刻表。 人们来到这里时期待有一个规划师，但当他们没有找到规划师时就离开了。 新名称就是事物的实际名称。 您所拥有的一切都不会丢失：每个 trainrouter.com 地址都会一步重定向到此处并保留其路径，因此旧书签、其他人文章中的旧链接以及旧搜索结果都准确地落在同一页面上的位置。 该重定向将永久保持不变。 地图、数据、路线页面及其域名后的地址都没有改变，你的浏览器记住的这个网站的明暗设置也没有改变，如果它背后的名称和其他所有东西一起整理的话，这些设置就会被悄悄地遗忘。 2026-08-11
  • 现在有一千一百行是从描述它们的关系中得出的，而不是从对它们的搜索中得出的。 直到今天，这里的大多数“OSM追踪”线路都是通过将轨道拉到走廊内并寻找穿过它的路径来找到的，这就是推理，推理选择了错误的铁路，其中两条并排运行并绕过它所找到的线路，直到线路位于离铁轨几百米的地方。 路线关系完全是另一回事：知道铁路的人按顺序列出了其使用的确切方式。 现在，地图集通过询问火车停靠的车站来询问火车属于哪个关系，因为关系列出了它所服务的车站，而邻近度无法区分服务和它碰巧共享的轨道。 在 1,247 条路线中，647 条由覆盖整个卡的一个关系应答，176 条由一系列关系应答。 根据这些答案重新绘制了 1,093 条线，几乎没有一条是对齐方式的变化：其中 1,098 条候选线是粗略绘制的同一条铁路，现在与 OpenStreetMap 的中位数为四米，而不是近似值。 该地图集从命名关系中绘制了 1,122 条线，并根据真实轨迹测量了其中 1,243 条线，一致性达 98%。 2026-08-10
  • 有二十二条路线被故意保留下来，与其悄悄地重新绘制它们，不如说原因。 他们的关系将使线路移动超过一公里，这是另一条铁路的标志，而不是同一条铁路的更精细的绘图。 基辅到利沃夫距离其候选铁路有 42 公里，而罗罗斯线则有 51 公里，这要么是一个严重错误的绘图，要么完全是另一条铁路的关系，如果没有人读过这种关系的实际名称，这里就无法分辨出哪条铁路。 他们保留当前的绘图，直到完成为止。 另外 424 条路线根本没有关系，这不是方法的失败，而是地图的事实：OpenStreetMap 与非洲、中亚和南美洲的大部分地区没有路线关系。 2026-08-10

错误通常会在一天之内得到修复：更正日志。
